name: XML to JSON
summary: Convert XML to JSON with @attributes and arrays for repeated tags — locally.
description: Paste XML and get structured JSON. Element attributes become @name fields, text becomes strings (or #text when mixed), and repeated sibling tags become arrays. Best-effort for well-formed XML without namespaces complexity. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: Are namespaces fully supported?
faqs.answer: Prefixed names are kept as-is. Complex namespace rewriting is out of scope for this tool.

faqs.question: How are repeated tags handled?
faqs.answer: Sibling elements with the same name become a JSON array.

faqs.question: Is my XML uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing runs entirely in your browser.
